items.title: Nepal seeks mountain-specific early warning systems after devastating flood
items.blurb: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal calls for better cross-border data sharing, improved high-altitude monitoring and predictable climate finance to protect vulnerable communities.

items.title: 10 killed, five injured as electric microbus plunges off road in Makawanpur
items.blurb: The vehicle was carrying passengers from Sarlahi returning home for Chhath. The driver and one passenger have been identified, while a three-year-old boy was rescued alive.

items.title: Nepal PM’s India visit to cover entire spectrum of bilateral ties, says New Delhi
items.blurb: Kathmandu is seeking progress on reconstruction assistance, air connectivity, energy cooperation and longstanding bilateral issues as the two sides discuss arrangements for the prime minister’s visit.
